name: Drush DTK
description: Opt-in token-saving output compression for common Drush commands, built for AI agents (enable via --ai-compress, DTK_COMPRESS=1, or config).
project_description: Drush DTK - the "Drush Token Killer" - provides opt-in, token-saving output defaults for common Drush commands. Inspired by RTK (the "Rust Token Killer"), it shrinks the output of frequently-run, read-only Drush commands so AI agents (and humans) spend far fewer tokens reading them. Enabling the module changes nothing by default; compression is switched on per command with --ai-compress, per session with the DTK_COMPRESS environment variable (recommended for agents, whose Drush wrappers make injecting flags awkward), or permanently via the dtk.settings 'compress' config. When active, lightweight Drush hooks select a compact set of fields and force CSV output (dropping the wide ASCII-table chrome) for supported core and contrib commands, but only when the user has not already requested specific output. --no-ai-compress always wins and restores native output; DTK_COMPRESS=0/false/no/off explicitly disables it. There is deliberately no TTY or 'am I an agent?' detection. No new everyday commands are added - it only alters existing command output - except a one-time 'drush dtk:install' helper that wires DTK_COMPRESS=1 (or the site-wide config opt-in inside containers) into an AI agent's project configuration.
